summary: Baird Medical Investment Holdings filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) disclosing a November 2, 2026 Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter finding its ordinary shares closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, breaching Rule 5550(a)(2). Shares continue trading under BDMD. The company has a 180-day compliance period to May 3, 2027, with a possible second 180-day grace period if it meets market-value and initial listing standards and submits a cure plan. Two press releases accompanied the notice, including one on share-price volatility. Watch for reverse-split or cure disclosures before the deadline.
